consistency_checks.check: Gravidity 1 (first pregnancy) but prior deliveries above 0
consistency_checks.decision: Flag as qc_parity_conflict; keep the rows; run a sensitivity cohort without them

consistency_checks.check: Prior deliveries at or above gravidity
consistency_checks.decision: Same flag; gravidity counts the current pregnancy, so prior deliveries must be smaller

consistency_checks.check: Twin at booking and twin at delivery
consistency_checks.decision: The two fields barely overlap; booking field kept only as a weak predictor

consistency_checks.check: EDD minus LMP within 275 to 285 days (expected about 280)
consistency_checks.decision: Dates are not used: fewer than a quarter agree with each other and years range from 1985 to 2202
Not used; gestational age comes from pregnant_week_number_v1

consistency_checks.check: Visit 1 parsed BP at or above 140/90 while the derived flag is 0
consistency_checks.decision: Derived flag never used; BP features come from the parsed readings

consistency_checks.check: Visit 2 parsed BP at or above 140/90 (derived flag holds text, not 0 or 1)
Booking weight differs from visit 1 weight by more than 5 kg
consistency_checks.decision: Use visit 1 weight; booking weight_kg is not used

consistency_checks.check: Age outside 12 to 55 years (raw range 11 to 121)
Height outside 130 to 200 cm (raw range 0 to 180)
Weight change visit 1 to 2 beyond plus or minus 15 kg
consistency_checks.decision: Handled by the weekly weight change bound (Section 9)
Likely an export error; both features are kept as specified but the training notebook should use only one

cohort_flow.rule: Visit 1 weight and gestational week present
Visit 2 block present (weight and week recorded)
GA at visit 2 greater than GA at visit 1
GA at visit 2 at or below 28 weeks
